notes.finding: Bankomat says most machines have surveillance. This does not identify which machines or camera coordinates; seek per-site evidence before mapping.
SEB documents surveillance at premises and ATMs, without a per-camera location list. Treat as source lead, not a pin.
Operator notices establish monitoring in some facilities, not individual camera positions. A site-level notice record needs a location-specific source and must remain distinct from a camera pin.

A bounded public OSM query on 2026-09-24 found 73 surveillance objects without surveillance:type in the Stockholm area; these require object-by-object verification before becoming camera candidates. Query man_made=surveillance including ways, and inspect camera:direction, camera:type, and source tags.

VViS roadside stations can include a camera taking road-condition still images. Search WeatherMeasurepoint and official open API documentation for unique station IDs, coordinates, image permission, and direction; a free API key may be required. Deduplicate against existing traffic records.

Published camera permit decisions can identify surveilled sites and sometimes coverage plans, but a site address does not by itself identify each lens coordinate or active installation. Keep site/area leads distinct from camera pins.
Polisen and Stockholm city publish monitoring purposes and some areas. Drone and temporary zones must be modeled as time-bounded areas, not fixed camera pins.
